title: updates to highcharter break 04_report/stocks.Rmd
description:
I'm not sure which is the relevant upstream source in which to make this correction, but 

```r
  hc_add_series_ohlc(prices, yAxis=0, name= params$symbol) %>% 
  hc_add_series_xts(prices[,paste0(params$symbol,".Volume")], name="Volume", type="column", yAxis=1) %>%
```

must now be written 

```r
  hc_add_series(type = "ohlc", prices, yAxis=0, name= params$symbol) %>%
  hc_add_series(type = "xts", prices[,paste0(params$symbol,".Volume")], name="Volume", type="column", yAxis=1) %>%
```

or the assets can't be deployed.
